svg.title: Square-to-round trumpet bell - 51 rings of 1 ply, 10mm square throat to ø86.0mm round rim
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Bessel horn, gamma 0.7, 10mm square throat to ø86.0mm round rim over 153mm. The section morphs square to round on the linear schedule, holding area. Each ring is 1 lamination(s) of 3mm ply, 3mm of rise, seating on the ring below over 3.0mm per side. Rings stack; they do not telescope.
